brand_identity.name: Donna Devlin Designs
brand_identity.tagline: Handcrafted Choke-Free Dog Walking Vests, Step-In Harnesses & Whimsical Accessories
brand_identity.mission: USA-made boutique pet wear engineered with delicate neck protection and artisan cotton fabrics for stylish, safe daily walks.

fonts.heading: Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond (Serif, High character, warm boutique editorial feel)
fonts.body: Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans (Clean geometric sans with friendly curves)
fonts.accent_mono: JetBrains Mono / Space Mono (For product codes, sizes, and technical choke-free specs)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900

colors.guidelines: Warm parchment base (#FDFBF7) with rich vintage navy (#1C2A39) and warm terracotta (#D96B43) accents. Never use pure black #000000. Use soft warm borders and high contrast for text readability.

grids.marketing_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
grids.product_carousel: flex gap-6 overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory scrollbar-none py-4

layouts.announcement_bar: Sticky top notification strip with rotating promo messages (e.g. Free US Shipping on Orders $75+ | Handcrafted in USA | Choke-Free Safety Guaranteed)
layouts.header: Sticky glassmorphism header backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FDFBF7]/90 border-b border-[#1C2A39]/10 with brand mark logo, navigation links, quick search, wishlist, and cart drawer trigger with counter badge
layouts.kinetic_hero: Split desktop hero with line-by-line staggered text reveal on left, and a frame-by-frame gif-like animated photo slideshow on right displaying dog vests in action
layouts.editorial_marquee: Slow-moving horizontal marquee ribbon in pale sage with warm terracotta text showcasing brand pillars: 'Choke-Free Design • USA Handcrafted • Soft 100% Cotton • Whimsical Prints • Dual D-Ring Security • Made for Delicate Necks'
layouts.press_marquee: Featured in logo strip with monochrome press badges (Vogue Pets, Dogster, Modern Dog Magazine, Pet Style Quarterly, Pet Bazaar)
layouts.product_section: Interactive carousels with hover image swap (primary studio shot transitions smoothly to a secondary lifestyle photo on hover), quick view modal trigger, size badges, and price
layouts.choke_free_breakdown: Interactive diagram explaining standard collar neck pressure vs. Donna Devlin chest-distribution choke-free harness design with toggle view
layouts.cart_drawer: Slide-out right-side drawer with item list, size variations, promo code input, free shipping progress bar, subtotal, and Stripe checkout action
layouts.contact_section: Custom enquiry form for custom sizing, wholesale requests, or sizing support

effects: Image-swap transition on product cards: smooth opacity + 1.05 scale zoom on hover mimicking a living GIF effect
Kinetic text reveal: words mask-up from overflow-hidden lines on viewport scroll
Infinite slow marquee: smooth CSS transform drift at 30s duration
Modal Quick View: scale and fade-in with backdrop blur
Cart drawer: spring slide-in from right screen edge

accessibility.contrast: All text meets WCAG AA min 4.5:1 ratio against #FDFBF7 and white cards
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring ring-2 ring-[#D96B43] outline-none for interactive items
accessibility.data_testids: Mandatory data-testid attributes on all buttons, inputs, navigation links, product cards, and cart actions

Coastal Breeze Matching Lead & Bag Holder

3d_libraries.usage: Not required for lightweight boutique performance, rely on Framer Motion frame-by-frame gif image motion and SVG choke-free chest distribution diagram.

instructions_to_main_agent: Recreate the exact motion, kinetic typography, carousel interaction, quick-view, and announcement bar structure inspired by foundmyanimal.com, but with all Donna Devlin Designs boutique business information and colors.
Implement slide-out Cart Drawer with quantity controls, sizing options, free shipping calculator ($75 threshold), and Stripe checkout mock/integration.
Ensure image hover on all product cards creates a lively GIF-like 2-frame motion effect.
Use Playfair Display font styling (or serif Google fonts) for headlines and Outfit/Sans for body to give an award-winning boutique look.
Ensure full responsiveness from mobile to 4k displays, with mobile hamburger navigation and touch-friendly swiping carousels.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all key interactive elements including buttons, cart items, size options, and inputs.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App text-align: center).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or crisp sharp buttons with hover micro-animations.
NEVER use generic AI emoji characters for icons; use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, entrance animations.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
